name: suspension trainer pike
description: Plank with feet in suspension straps, piking the hips up to work the abs and shoulders.
instructions: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.
